test_cases.test_name: Document Assignment and Electronic Acknowledgment Workflow
test_cases.objective: Verify that documents can be successfully assigned to users and groups via the vendor UI and that users can complete the electronic acknowledgment process.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test user accounts and groups are created
Test documents are loaded into the system
User has permissions to assign documents

test_steps.action: Log into the system with a manager-level account that has document assignment permissions.
test_steps.expected_result: System login is successful and the main dashboard is displayed.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of successful login and dashboard

test_steps.action: Navigate to the document assignment section within the vendor-provided user interface.
test_steps.expected_result: The document assignment interface loads correctly, showing options to select documents and assignees.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the document assignment interface

test_steps.action: Select a test document and assign it to a pre-defined test user group using the UI controls.
test_steps.expected_result: System confirms the assignment was successful and the task appears in the assignment queue.
data_to_capture: Name of assigned document and group

test_steps.action: Log out and log in as a user from the assigned group. Navigate to the user's acknowledgment dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: The assigned document is visible in the user's list of pending acknowledgments.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of user dashboard showing pending acknowledgment

test_steps.action: Open the assigned document, review it, and complete the vendor-provided electronic signature/acknowledgment process.
test_steps.expected_result: The system records the acknowledgment, the pending item is removed, and a completion timestamp is recorded.

test_steps.action: Log back in as the manager and view the standard acknowledgment report for the test document.
test_steps.expected_result: The report shows the test user has acknowledged the document, with the correct date and time.

acceptance_criteria: Document assignment to a group is successful via the vendor UI.
Assigned document appears correctly in the target user's dashboard.
Electronic acknowledgment process completes successfully and is recorded.
Acknowledgment report accurately reflects the completed user acknowledgment.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
Internal policy for tracking training and acknowledgment compliance
data_integrity_requirements: The audit trail must record the assignment event and the acknowledgment event with user ID and timestamp.
The acknowledgment record must be immutable once created.

test_cases.test_name: Automated Reminder and Manager Dashboard Verification
test_cases.objective: Validate that the system sends automated reminders for overdue acknowledgments and that role-based dashboards correctly display assignment statuses to managers.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Vendor scheduler is configured for reminders
Test documents are assigned with past-due dates
Manager-level test account exists

test_steps.action: Log into the system as an administrator and configure the vendor scheduler to send reminders for acknowledgments overdue by 1 day.
test_steps.expected_result: Scheduler configuration is saved successfully.

test_steps.action: Create a test assignment for a document with a due date set in the past to trigger the reminder logic.
test_steps.expected_result: Assignment is created successfully and is immediately flagged as overdue.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of assignment showing overdue status

test_steps.action: Force the execution of the reminder job or wait for the scheduled run time. Check the email system or notification log.
test_steps.expected_result: An automated reminder notification is generated and sent for the overdue assignment.
data_to_capture: Screenshot or log entry proving reminder was sent

test_steps.action: Log into the system with a manager-level account and access the role-based dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: The dashboard loads and displays summary statistics and a list of document assignments.

test_steps.action: Filter the dashboard view to show overdue acknowledgments and verify the test assignment is listed.
test_steps.expected_result: The test overdue assignment is correctly displayed in the filtered list on the dashboard.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of dashboard showing the overdue assignment

test_steps.action: Generate a standard acknowledgment report from the dashboard for all overdue items.
test_steps.expected_result: The report generates in less than 10 seconds and includes the test overdue assignment.
data_to_capture: Time taken to generate the report

acceptance_criteria: The vendor scheduler successfully triggers and sends an automated reminder for an overdue acknowledgment.
The manager dashboard correctly displays assignment statuses, including overdue items.
The standard acknowledgment report for overdue items generates in less than 10 seconds.
regulatory_basis: Internal requirements for timely completion of mandatory reading
Good Documentation Practice (GDP) for maintaining complete records
data_integrity_requirements: Reminder events must be logged in the audit trail.
Dashboard data must be a real-time reflection of the current system status.

test_cases.test_name: High Volume Assignment and Reporting Performance Test
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can handle 10,000 document assignments per day and generate reports for 50k records in under 10 seconds as specified in performance requirements.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test environment with performance monitoring tools
Test dataset of 50,000+ acknowledgment records
Performance baseline established

test_steps.action: Load test environment with 10,000 document assignments using automated script or test tool
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully processes all 10,000 assignments without errors or performance degradation
data_to_capture: System resource utilization (CPU, memory, disk I/O)

test_steps.action: Execute standard acknowledgment report generation for 50,000+ records using vendor reporting interface
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation completes in less than 10 seconds as specified in URS-021-009
data_to_capture: System performance metrics during report generation

acceptance_criteria: System processes 10,000 assignments within acceptable performance thresholds
Report generation completes in under 10 seconds for 50k records
No system crashes or critical errors during high volume operations
data_integrity_requirements: All assignment and acknowledgment data must be complete and accurate
Performance metrics must be reliably captured and documented
No data loss or corruption during high volume operations

test_cases.test_name: Active Directory Integration and User Group Synchronization Test
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can successfully synchronize user groups from Active Directory using the standard vendor-provided connector as specified in integration requirements.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Active Directory test environment available
Standard AD connector installed and configured
Test user groups created in Active Directory

test_steps.action: Configure the standard AD connector with appropriate connection parameters and synchronization settings
test_steps.expected_result: Connector configuration is successfully saved and validated by the system

test_steps.action: Initiate manual synchronization of user groups from Active Directory to the document acknowledgment system
test_steps.expected_result: User groups are successfully synchronized from AD to the system without errors
data_to_capture: Synchronization log details and any errors

test_steps.action: Verify synchronized user groups appear in the document assignment interface and can be used for document assignments
test_steps.expected_result: All synchronized AD groups are available for document assignment in the vendor UI as specified in URS-021-001
data_to_capture: List of available groups in assignment interface

acceptance_criteria: AD connector successfully synchronizes user groups without errors
Synchronized groups are available for document assignment
Group membership data is accurately maintained between systems
data_integrity_requirements: User group data must be accurately synchronized between systems
No data corruption during synchronization process
Group membership integrity must be maintained

test_cases.test_name: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignments and Acknowledgments
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system maintains a complete and unalterable audit trail for all document assignment and acknowledgment activities as required by regulatory standards.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test users with various roles created
Documents available for assignment
Audit trail functionality enabled

test_steps.action: Assign a document to a test user using the vendor UI and record the assignment details
test_steps.expected_result: Assignment is successfully completed and visible in the user's pending acknowledgments

test_steps.action: Have the test user acknowledge the document using the electronic signature feature
test_steps.expected_result: Document acknowledgment is successfully recorded with electronic signature

test_steps.action: Access the audit trail report for the specific document and user
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail displays complete record of assignment and acknowledgment events
data_to_capture: Audit trail entries for both assignment and acknowledgment

test_steps.action: Verify audit trail entries cannot be modified or deleted by any user role
test_steps.expected_result: All audit trail entries are read-only and protected from modification

acceptance_criteria: Audit trail captures all assignment and acknowledgment events with complete metadata
Audit trail entries are timestamped accurately and sequentially
No modifications to audit trail are possible by any user role
All captured data aligns with regulatory record-keeping requirements
data_integrity_requirements: ALCOA+ principles applied to all audit trail data
Immutable record storage
Accurate timestamping with timezone information
Complete user identification in all entries

test_cases.test_name: Retention Policy Compliance for Acknowledgment Records
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system properly maintains acknowledgment records according to the configured retention policy and prevents premature deletion.
prerequisites: System with configured retention policy
Historical acknowledgment records available
Administrator access configured
Retention policy documentation available

test_steps.action: Review the configured retention policy settings in the system administration interface
test_steps.expected_result: Retention policy is configured according to organizational requirements

test_steps.action: Identify acknowledgment records that have reached their retention period expiration
test_steps.expected_result: System correctly identifies records eligible for retention processing

test_steps.action: Attempt to delete acknowledgment records that have not reached retention expiration
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents deletion of records still within retention period

test_steps.action: Verify system handling of records that have exceeded retention period (archive/delete based on configuration)
test_steps.expected_result: System processes expired records according to configured retention policy

acceptance_criteria: Retention policy configuration matches organizational requirements
System prevents deletion of records within retention period
Expired records are processed according to policy
All retention activities are logged in audit trail
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 record retention requirements
EU GMP Annex 11 data retention guidelines
ICH Q9 quality risk management principles
data_integrity_requirements: Retention period enforcement
Prevention of premature deletion
Secure archive process for expired records
Audit trail of retention activities

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Dashboard Access and Functionality Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that role-based dashboards provide appropriate access and functionality to managers as specified in URS-021-004.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test users with different manager roles created
Document assignments exist in the system
User groups are synchronized from AD

test_steps.action: Log in as a Quality Manager user and navigate to the manager dashboard
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard displays with complete view of all assigned documents and acknowledgment statuses across all departments

test_steps.action: Log in as a Department Manager user and navigate to the manager dashboard
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard displays with restricted view showing only documents assigned to the manager's specific department
data_to_capture: List of visible documents and users

test_steps.action: Generate a standard acknowledgment report from each manager dashboard
test_steps.expected_result: Report generates successfully with appropriate data scope based on user role and displays in less than 10 seconds

acceptance_criteria: All role-based dashboards display appropriate data scope
Dashboard functions operate correctly for each role
Reports generate within specified performance requirements
data_integrity_requirements: Dashboard must display accurate and current acknowledgment status data
Role-based access restrictions must be consistently enforced
urs_requirements: URS-021-004: Provide role-based dashboards for managers
related_tests: OQ-002: Automated Reminder and Manager Dashboard Verification
OQ-003: High Volume Assignment and Reporting Performance Test

test_cases.test_name: Electronic Signature Compliance and Validity Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that electronic acknowledgment signatures comply with regulatory requirements and maintain validity as specified in URS-021-005.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test users created with document assignments
Electronic signature configuration completed

test_steps.action: Assign a document to a test user and have them complete the acknowledgment process
test_steps.expected_result: System captures electronic signature with timestamp, user identity, and meaning of signature (acknowledgment)
data_to_capture: Signature metadata including timestamp and user identity

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail entry for the electronic signature event
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail contains complete record of signature including all required elements per 21 CFR Part 11

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify an acknowledged document record after signature capture
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents modification of signed records or requires re-signature with appropriate audit trail entries
data_to_capture: Audit trail entries for modification attempts

acceptance_criteria: Electronic signatures contain all required regulatory elements
Signatures are non-repudiable and securely linked to user identity
Signed records are protected from unauthorized modification
regulatory_basis: FDA Guidance on Electronic Systems Compliance
data_integrity_requirements: Electronic signatures must be secure, non-repudiable, and compliant with 21 CFR Part 11
Signed records must be protected from modification after signature
urs_requirements: URS-021-005: Support vendor-provided electronic acknowledgment signature
URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Electronic Acknowledgment Workflow
OQ-005: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignments and Acknowledgments

test_cases.test_name: Document Assignment and Acknowledgment Workflow Validation
test_cases.objective: Verify the end-to-end workflow of assigning documents to users, sending automated reminders, and capturing electronic acknowledgments meets specified requirements.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test users with different roles are created
Test documents are loaded into the system
User groups are synchronized from Active Directory

test_steps.action: Log into the system as a document control administrator and navigate to the document assignment interface.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the document assignment dashboard with options to assign documents to users and groups.

test_steps.action: Assign a test policy/SOP to a specific user and a user group using the vendor UI.
test_steps.expected_result: System confirms successful assignment and displays the assignment in the pending acknowledgments list.

test_steps.action: Log in as an assigned user and navigate to the acknowledgment section.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the assigned document requiring acknowledgment with electronic signature option.

test_steps.action: Complete the electronic acknowledgment process by reviewing and signing the document.
test_steps.expected_result: System records the acknowledgment with timestamp and electronic signature, updating the status to completed.

test_steps.action: Verify that automated reminders are sent according to the vendor scheduler for unacknowledged documents.
test_steps.expected_result: System sends reminder notifications to users with pending acknowledgments as per configured schedule.

acceptance_criteria: Documents are successfully assigned to users and groups
Electronic acknowledgments are properly captured and stored
Automated reminders are sent according to schedule
Acknowledgment status is accurately updated in real-time
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
data_integrity_requirements: Electronic signatures must be securely linked to respective records
Acknowledgment timestamps must be accurate and non-modifiable
All assignment and acknowledgment transactions must be recorded in audit trail

test_cases.test_name: Standard Acknowledgment Report Generation and Performance Validation
test_cases.objective: Verify that standard acknowledgment reports can be generated accurately and meet performance requirements for large datasets.
prerequisites: System contains at least 50,000 acknowledgment records
Test user with manager role permissions
Reporting module is configured and accessible

test_steps.action: Log into the system as a manager and navigate to the standard acknowledgment reports section.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays available standard report templates for acknowledgment tracking.

test_steps.action: Select a comprehensive acknowledgment report template and configure parameters for a large dataset (50,000+ records).
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts report parameters and displays estimated generation time.

test_steps.action: Execute the report generation and start timing the process.
test_steps.expected_result: System processes the report request and begins generating the output.

test_steps.action: Monitor the report generation process until completion and record the total time.
test_steps.expected_result: Report completes generation within 10 seconds and displays accurate data for all 50,000+ records.

test_steps.action: Verify the accuracy and completeness of the generated report against the source data.
test_steps.expected_result: Report contains accurate acknowledgment data matching the database records with correct totals and status information.

acceptance_criteria: Reports generate in less than 10 seconds for 50,000+ records
All report data accurately reflects the source acknowledgment records
Standard report templates provide comprehensive acknowledgment tracking information
Role-based access controls properly restrict report access
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records Requirements
EU GMP Annex 11 - Reporting and Data Integrity
data_integrity_requirements: Report data must accurately reflect source records without modification
Report generation timestamps must be recorded in audit trail
Data exports must maintain referential integrity
